prompt: Produce an architecture and quality assessment of this service for a new team member and write it to codebase-analysis.md. Include: an executive summary, a codebase map and architecture overview with Mermaid diagrams, a SOLID evaluation, design patterns found, dependencies and integrations (with a Mermaid diagram), code quality and test assessment, security and performance, technical debt, and recommendations prioritized P0 to P2. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, list your assumptions in your final message, and finish the work.

checks.cmd: c=0; h=$(grep -E '^[[:space:]]*(#+[[:space:]]|[*][*][^*]+[*][*]:?[[:space:]]*$)' codebase-analysis.md 2>/dev/null); for p in 'executive|summary' 'map|structure|overview|architecture' 'solid' 'pattern' 'dependenc|integration' 'quality|test' 'security|performance' 'debt' 'recommend'; do printf '%s\n' "$h" | grep -qiE "$p" && c=$((c+1)); done; [ "$c" -ge 8 ]

c=0; for p in 'server\.js' 'handlers/items|items\.js' 'inventoryService' 'itemRepo' 'db\.js' 'config\.js' 'format\.js'; do cat codebase-analysis.md 2>/dev/null | grep -qiE "$p" && c=$((c+1)); done; [ "$c" -ge 5 ]

c=0; for p in 'at or below|<=|boundary|reorder' 'race|lost update|concurren|atomic|read.modify.write|interleav' 'fallback|hard.?cod' 'stack'; do cat codebase-analysis.md 2>/dev/null | grep -qiE "$p" && c=$((c+1)); done; [ "$c" -ge 3 ]

rubric.criterion: Describes the layers server.js to handlers to services to repository to db, and the Mermaid architecture diagram uses those component names.
The P0 recommendations include the SQL injection in itemRepo.searchByName and the missing input validation or admin-token check on adjustStock.
States that two test files cover only the service and repository, and that handlers and server are untested.
Technical debt lists at least two of: reorder boundary bug, lost update, hardcoded fallback token, stack trace in 500 response.
The executive summary is 3 to 5 sentences and mentions overall health, a strength and the most serious issue.
